fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-04-07, the complainant parked a blue car bearing registration number TN-28-YY-1076 near Kadal Nagar Bus Stand Area in Coimbatore and found the parking spot empty the next morning. The time of the incident was given as 08:05 on 2025-04-06. The complainant, Yogesh Arumugam, provided the contact number 9000000029. A witness, Elango Krishnan, reachable on 9000000081, was mentioned in the complaint. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. The complaint refers to another person whose identity could not be established. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly taken overnight from a residential parking spot.
fields.Keywords: car theft, vehicle, morning, car, CCTV, witness, bus stand
